title: eat shit & die 199
author: bpatrick
html: Why, when it’s been so long since I’ve posted, did I make this comic so long? Oh well, here it finally is. In case you haven’t heard the Bob & Bob film by Andrew Alonso won the Audience Choice Award at the Atlanta Underground Film Festival!
postClass: post-700 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-eatshitanddie tag-burly-guy uentry post-comic postonpage-1 odd post-author-bpatrick

comments.author: Leo W.
comments.html: I love this one. I can’t stop reading it.

comments.author: randomjackass
comments.html: Not sure if your familiar with comedian Doug Stanhope, but he has a bit in a similar vein. His bit on excess in moderation, paraphrased “Don’t drink a few beers every night, save them up and drink them all at once at the end of the week, other wise you’ll never get the full effect” http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mrrca_PmViw

comments.author: Erick
comments.html: I lolled when she barely moved in the jetpack. Hilarious.

comments.author: Marcus
comments.html: Do I spy a slight Neutral Milk Hotel reference, or have my eyes been poisoned to the point that I see them everywhere?

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html:
Should I consult the Pree-sisters regarding the whereabouts of that donkey’s eye? I wish I’d thought of that – I missed a great opportunity.

I may have Oliver Stoned this one. If it seems like I’m encouraging alcoholism then I botched this completely.

comments.author: FACE
comments.html: Good use of comedy to soften the raw message core. I usually feel like Akimbo punches me in the face; this time it gently caressed my jawline and poked my nose playfully.

comments.author: -evan.
comments.html: This strip is now my go-to when sharing how I feel about alcohol. Thank you.
